{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|For the Restoration Project to continue in earnest, the Telosian government must be made to see the cancer that Czerka has become. Their security division is merely an army of badge-bearing thugs. ''[&hellip;]'' But Czerka has imbedded itself within the government, using Telos' own laws to protect itself from censure or investigation. Legally, the Telosians can do nothing.|[[Chodo Habat]] to [[Meetra Surik]], regarding [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation's]] corruption in [[Telos IV|Telosian]] society|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
'''Cancer''' was a disease that could be [[Death/Legends|fatal]] to [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. [[Movac Arisster]] was afflicted with cancer as of [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] and given only six [[Time/Legends|months]] to live. [[Lung/Legends|Lung]] cancer was one of the known forms of cancer.<ref name="TRG1-77">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
